_note: Apple II Phantasie I art (VERSION 1.0; the p1-apple2 import, P1Apple2Art; reverse-engineering/apple2/phantasie1/GRAPHICS.md). Every picture is an Applesoft shape (SHAPES, 58 shapes) drawn at the game's SCALE / HCOLOR and turned into colour by an NTSC artifact model [~], except the title picture (HPIC). I's engine is II's Apple engine, so the pack is laid out as II's. The Apple's text is the ROM font (not on the disks): the remaster 5x7 font stands in. Screen kept at the remaster's 320 x 200 layout: Apple pictures (280 x 192 hi-res pixels) are drawn 1:1 in it. Map: the Apple draws its 20 x 26 map rotated against the remaster's 26 x 20 grid (FORMAT.md 3.6); here the tiles follow the remaster's grid, 22 x 20 cells of 7 x 6. A tile's colour fringes depend on its screen column on the Apple: the pack uses the even-column look. No town, item, ending or defeat pictures: the Apple's town is text and CEMETARY / FLASH? draw in BASIC (not replayed [~]); the Client draws its plain screens there.
name: Apple II
_tile_maps: OUTDOORS 5030-5040: map byte b < 120 draws shape 37 + b / 10 (7 x 6 cell) in HCOLOR INT(1 + .51 * class); b >= 120 is fog, not drawn (black tiles 120-255); the party is the XDRAW block 43 (5175). DUNGON 5025-5062: only cells next to the party are drawn; 4 x 4 marks: bytes 0-1 wall (31), 185-199 (32), 200-214 (33), 215-217 drawn in HCOLOR 0 (nothing: glyph 0), 218-220 (35), 221-255 (36), every other byte erases the cell (glyph 0); the party is the XDRAW cursor 30. Glyph numbers are the shape numbers.

title_sequence._note: HELLO prints STRATEGIC SIMULATIONS PRESENTS / VERSION 1.0 (text page, ROM font) and runs INTRO, which loads SHAPES and INFO, RECALLs HPIC onto hi-res page 1, shows it full-screen (lines 1000-1010) and waits for a key (1276); then the PHANTASIE / 1 - START IN PELNOR / 2 - CONTINUE text menu. Shown: HPIC until a key.

_portraits: portrait.{race}: the party figure (TOWN 2350-2356, record byte 168: races 7+ shape 26, DWARF / HALFLING / GNOME / PIXIE / SPRITE 25, HUMAN / ELF 19, or 27 for a MONK / PRIEST / WIZARD, which a race-keyed picture cannot show [~]) with the arm overlay 20 (idle) or 22 (attacking). The figures by body and pose are in figures/.
